subject: Hosted API pricing: usage package proposal and model surcharges
messages:
From: Ethan Blake <ethan.blake@brightship.com>
To: camila.reyes@redwood.com
Cc: sana.patel@brightship.com, procurement@brightship.com
Date: 2026-06-01T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing question — commit tiers + embeddings

Hi Camila,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our technical team liked the latency profile and the ability to pin models per route. Before we get to legal, procurement asked me for a concrete pricing outline so they can evaluate commit levels. A few specifics they want clarified:

- We expect ~1B tokens/month initially, ramping to ~4B over 12 months.
- We will use embeddings heavily for vector search (approx 250M embedding units/month at peak) plus chat generation for user-facing responses.
- Can you confirm how discounts apply across model families? Are embeddings priced differently than chat? What are the surcharges for premium models (e.g., Redwood-Pro or partner models)?
- Is it possible to structure a blended commit across embeddings + chat (so they can meet a single committed spend for a better blended per-token rate)?

Can you share a simple proposal/worksheet we can show procurement? Appreciate a target by COB Tuesday.

Best,
Ethan
Director, Platform Engineering, BrightShip

----
From: camila.reyes@redwood.com <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Blake <ethan.blake@brightship.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-01T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing question — commit tiers + embeddings

Hi Ethan — thanks for the clear ask (and great questions). I put together an initial worksheet attached, and high level answers below so you have something to show procurement quickly.

Short answers:
- Yes, we price embeddings and chat separately (different unit definitions) but can include them in a single committed contract as a blended-usage commit.
- Embedding "unit": we charge per 1K embedding units (roughly per 1K vectors processed). Chat/text is per-token. Discounts are applied by tier to the billable units and we provide a blended effective rate when you commit across both channels.
- Premium models (Redwood-Pro and select partner models) carry a model surcharge expressed as a % uplift on the standard per-token/unit price. That surcharge is explicit and only applies to tokens/units served by those models.

Row-of-fire example (from the attached spreadsheet):
- 12-month commit, $40k/month base commit (annualized $480k) -> base discounts kick in at 10% off standard list for chat tokens; embeddings receive 12% off list.
- Add-on: If you route >=50% of tokens to Redwood-Pro, surcharge of +15% applies on those tokens; we can cap total surcharge exposure in the contract (see options).
- Blended-rate option: commit $60k/mo across both channels; we compute monthly blended per-token equivalent for budgeting and apply a floor for minimum spend allocation to embeddings (to avoid over-crediting).

Next steps I recommend:
1) I’ll work with Marissa to produce a recommended proposal with two commit options (conservative ramp and aspirational ramp) and explicit surcharge caps.
2) Rishi will confirm finance constraints (max aggregate discount % and approval cadence).
3) If that looks good, we’ll share a short SOW + pricing sheet you can attach to procurement.

I’ll aim to get the proposal to you by EOD Monday.

Thanks —
Camila
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Signature: Camila Reyes | Account Executive | Redwood Inference | camila.reyes@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

Attachment: redwood-pricing-matrix-061026.xlsx

From: Ethan Blake <ethan.blake@brightship.com>
To: camila.reyes@redwood.com
Cc: sana.patel@brightship.com, procurement@brightship.com
Date: 2026-06-02T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing question — commit tiers + embeddings

Hi Camila — thanks for the quick primer and the worksheet. A couple of clarifying items from procurement: 

- Procurement is comfortable with blended commits but needs an allocation table we can show finance that maps committed dollars to expected tokens (chat) and embedding units by month (they want month-by-month ramp assumptions).
- They are nervous about the premium model surcharge because our product team intends to try Redwood-Pro for some experiments; we’d prefer a surcharge cap (e.g., cap surcharge exposure to $7k/month or a % cap on spend).
- On overages: we need a simple, predictable overage multiplier (e.g., 1.1x list price for overage tokens), and an option to purchase burst credits.

Would appreciate that in the formal proposal. Also can you confirm SOC2 scope for hosted API (procurement asked).

If you can add those to the SOW and pricing sheet, procurement and I can review next week.

Thanks,
Ethan

----
From: marissa.cole@redwood.com <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Blake <ethan.blake@brightship.com>
Cc: camila.reyes@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-03T11:10:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Hosted API pricing question — commit tiers + embeddings

Hi Ethan — following up with the formal proposal attached. Key points (summary):

1) Commit options (12-month term)
- Option A (Conservative ramp): $35k/mo commitment first 3 months, $50k/mo months 4-12. Annualized effective discount on chat tokens: 8% at typical usage; embeddings: 10%.
- Option B (Accelerated ramp): $60k/mo flat. Chat tokens: 12% off list; embeddings: 15% off list. This option gives the best blended per-unit economics once you hit the 1B+ token threshold.

2) Model surcharge and cap
- Redwood-Pro surcharge: +15% on tokens routed to Redwood-Pro.
- Cap options: we can cap surcharge exposure to either $7k/month or 8% of your monthly committed spend (whichever is lower). This protects you during experimentation.

3) Blended commit mechanics
- We include a monthly allocation worksheet in the attachment that converts committed dollars to committed chat tokens and embedding units using your provided ramp assumptions. Unused committed dollars roll forward for the term (up to 3 months) to accommodate ramp variability.

4) Overages and burst credits
- Standard overage: 1.1x list for chat tokens, 1.05x list for embeddings.
- Burst credits available via one-time purchase at list price; we’ll include an option to pre-purchase a 20% buffer at a 5% discount on list.

5) Compliance
- Hosted API covered under Redwood SOC 2 Type II (we attach the SOC 2 summary and can provide the full report under NDA).

Attachments: BrightShip_SOW_v1.pdf, redwood-pricing-matrix-061026.xlsx, SOC2_summary.pdf

Rishi — can you confirm finance OK on the discount bands and the surcharge cap?

Ethan — if this looks aligned I’ll convert the SOW to a short form and kick off DocuSign.

Best,
Marissa
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference

From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-06-05T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Hosted API pricing question — commit tiers + embeddings

Quick finance note (approved subject to legal review):
- Discount bands as listed are within acceptable ranges for a first-year committed ARR of $480k+. For Option B (higher commit), finance approves up to 15% effective discount on chat and 18% on embeddings if blended ARR > $720k.
- Surcharge cap: approve the $7k/month cap OR 8% of committed spend (we prefer the % cap for larger deals; either option is acceptable).
- Overages: 1.1x for chat and 1.05x for embeddings is fine. Add language that overage charges are reconciled monthly and invoiced with 30-day terms.

Marissa/Camila — please update the SOW to include these finance-approved thresholds and send to Ethan for signature.

Rishi
Director, Finance | Redwood Inference
